text: env-facts 是一个 DSH 上下文插件：它向运行时上下文快照加入带有采集时间的结构化环境事实块。插件通过 systemPrompt 注册 env:facts 上下文，并从当前会话读取工作目录、文件策略、可用的审批策略、GUI 地址和会话标识；缺少某项服务或数据时会省略该字段。它按会话缓存事实内容，仅在事实变化时更新时间戳，使稳定环境下生成的文本保持一致。适合希望模型上下文中包含清晰、可追溯环境状态的 DSH 使用者。README 所述安装方式为将包目录作为本地 bundle 安装；代码中未见 API 密钥或外部服务调用。

env-facts adds timestamped environment facts to DSH runtime context. It records a session's working directory, file policy, approval policy, GUI address, and session ID; missing values are omitted. Per-session caching refreshes the timestamp only when facts change. Install it as a local bundle.

@local/env-facts README · env-facts — DSH plugin: structured environment facts with an as-of stamp：A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Host plugin that adds a machine-readable fact block with its
capture time to the runtime-context snapshot:

```
As of 2026-10-25T12:34:56.789Z
<env>
cwd: "F:\\workspace"
file_policy: danger-full-access

The built-in snapshot lists these facts as prose and carries no timestamp; this plugin adds
both a structured form and an `As of` time without touching the DSH installation.
section: env-facts — DSH plugin: structured environment facts with an as-of stamp

text:
@local/env-facts README · Why the as-of stamp is computed this way：The snapshot text participates in DSH's dedupe: while the environment is stable the snapshot
is **not re-sent** (an audit of `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3` measured 186 model steps producing a single
snapshot). Writing a fresh timestamp every step would defeat that dedupe and emit one message
per step.
section: Why the as-of stamp is computed this way

@local/env-facts README · Facts and their sources：| Field | Source |
|---|---|
| `cwd` | `workingDirectory.get(session)` |
| `file_policy` | `sandboxPolicy.resolve({ session }).mode` |
| `approval_policy` | `approval.overrideOf(session)` (omitted when unset) |
| `gui_url` | `webApp.getAdvertisedUrl()` |
| `session` | `session.id` |

A missing service or fact is simply omitted; it never fails assembly.

@local/env-facts README · Install：Install the package directory as a local bundle with `plugin_manager` (`install_bundle`).
The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, which inserts the `env-facts` row.

@local/env-facts README · `upstream-patch/`：This directory contains two patches against `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` tag
`dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3` that move the same idea into the core (snapshot header constant + stamp at
emission, dedupe by body). They are provided for reference and for the upstream project; see
`upstream-patch/PR.md`.
